💡 RuView | Rust
🎯 Primary Use Case: To provide non-intrusive, camera-free sensing of human presence, activity, and vital signs within an environment by leveraging existing WiFi infrastructure.
✨ Key Features: • Real-time spatial intelligence and sensing through WiFi signals • Contactless vital sign monitoring (breathing and heart rate) • Presence detection and occupancy tracking • Activity recognition (walking, sitting, gestures, falls)
📖 Summary: RuView is a Rust-based platform that transforms ordinary WiFi signals into real-time spatial intelligence and vital sign monitoring. It uses low-cost ESP32 sensors to detect presence, track movement, measure breathing and heart rate, and even recognize activities, all without cameras or wearables.
